ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Fraud in Federal Funding
ideas.description: This story would investigate the use of federal funding and potential fraud in the non-profit sector.
questions: What are the most common types of fraud in federal funding?
How can fraud be prevented in the non-profit sector?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and corruption in the non-profit sector, highlighting the need for increased oversight and accountability.
